description: Today, Lindsey Graham passed away, suddenly. His unexpected passing is troubling to the No MOE Corruption campaign as Senator Graham was the only ally to Moe at the federal level when it came to exposing corruption in the judiciary, specifically the Middle District of Florida. Embry J. Kidd testifies before the Senate Judiciary Committee during…
title: The Passing of Lindsey Graham hurts the Anti-Corruption Movement – No MOE Corruption
